Weekend moves follow Labour Code art. 105.5 (observed: next-weekday). When a moved holiday lands on another holiday (Victory Day on a Sunday and Flag Day on the Monday, as in 2026) the law moves the rest day again; the engine does not resolve such collisions, so hubs confirm them against the Cabinet's annual calendar.
